summary: Third backend iteration for AMASS API. Focus: NEW analytics endpoints (POST /api/properties/{id}/view, GET /api/agent/listings-analytics) + updated /api/favorites/toggle event writes + refactored /api/agent/dashboard shape (leads_30d & appointments_30d REMOVED, favorites_30d ADDED, views_30d now REAL from property_events). Ran 31 pytest cases (20 new analytics + 11 preserved agent endpoint tests updated for new dashboard shape). All 31 pass (100%). View dedupe (same user/day counts once), multi-user separation, anonymous view dedupe, favorite/unfavorite event semantics (favorites_30d does NOT decrement on unfavorite), per-listing analytics counts, and cross-agent isolation all verified. Regression on /auth/login, /properties, /properties/{id}, /favorites/toggle, /agent/leads, /agent/listings all still 200.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 938 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, properties.py, analytics.py, agent.py, favorites.py, marketplace.py, ai.py, seed.py) before more features land.

log_event() view dedupe uses UTC day boundary — correct and consistent, but agents in Africa/Lagos (UTC+1) will see the counter reset at 01:00 local time rather than midnight local. Consider documenting or normalizing to project timezone.

Anonymous view dedupe uses `user_id: None` as the dedupe key — this means ALL anonymous traffic across all devices/sessions in a day counts as ONE view for a given listing. In production consider fingerprinting via IP/session cookie so distinct visitors are counted separately.

/api/agent/listings-analytics aggregation returns a single row per listing but does not order results — the frontend will see an undefined ordering. Consider sorting by created_at DESC or views DESC for a stable UX.
Startup event still uses deprecated @app.on_event — carry-over from iter 1, still safe.

No index on property_events collection — with growing traffic, dashboard aggregations (count_documents on property_id/event_type/created_at, and the $group in analytics) will slow down. Recommend creating index on (property_id, event_type, created_at) and (property_id, event_type, user_id) for dedupe query.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new analytics endpoints working perfectly. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_analytics.py + conftest fixtures (base_url, api_client, demo_token, auth_headers). Helper `_register_fresh_user(base_url, api_client, tag)` returns (headers, user) for isolation tests. View dedupe key: (property_id, event_type='view', user_id, day_start_UTC). Favorite counting: `favorite` events accumulate; `unfavorite` events are logged but do NOT decrement favorites_30d. Dashboard stats shape is now: {listings, active, verified, views_30d, favorites_30d, total_value} — NO leads_30d/appointments_30d. Listings-analytics row shape: {property_id, title, image, price, status, verified, views, favorites}.
